This comparison analyzes the proportion of atrial fibrillation patients admitted with ischemic stroke or stroke of unknown type who had redeemed a prescription for oral anticoagulant (AK) treatment within 100 days prior to their admission, based on LPR data. This metric is critical for evaluating the effectiveness of stroke prevention strategies and medication adherence among vulnerable patients across different Danish regions.

According to the 2023 data, the national average for [[danmark|Danmark]] was 65.8%, meaning 726 out of 1,104 patients had redeemed their oral anticoagulant prescription before their stroke admission [^src1]. Among the specific regions, [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] was the clear leader, recording the highest proportion of patients with a redeemed prescription at 70.6% (161 out of 228 patients) [^src1]. Conversely, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] was the trailer, with the lowest proportion at 63.0% (136 out of 216 patients) [^src1]. 

The remaining regions fell between these extremes: [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] at 67.3%, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] at 66.4%, and [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] at 63.5% [^src1]. [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] stands out as a positive outlier, performing roughly 4 to 7 percentage points better than the other regions and the national average [^src1]. Because this comparison is based on a single dated section from the 2023 report, no longitudinal trends or changes over time can be established from this data alone [^src1]. Furthermore, the data does not specify any explicit target or threshold for this metric, meaning no regions can be formally classified as meeting or missing a standardized goal [^src1].

For broader context on the national registry infrastructure, general methodology, and other related cardiovascular indicators, readers can consult the foundational chapters and additional indicator sections of the 2023 report [^src2] [^src3] [^src8] [^src9] [^src10] [^src11] [^src12] [^src14], as well as the 2024 follow-up analyses [^src4] [^src5] [^src6] [^src7] [^src13] [^src15] [^src16] [^src17] [^src18] [^src19].
